Project: Enterprise Reconciliation & Transaction Lifecycle Platform (ERTLP)

opportunities for standardization across reconciliation platforms.  
• Supported Operating Model Transformation initiatives by redesigning reconciliation workflows, improving governance, and 
enhancing operational controls across trade, cash, and securities reconciliation.

strategic transformation initiatives.

• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including defect management, resolution tracking, and business sign-off

• Ensure adherence to risk and control frameworks, including audit trails, maker-checker controls, and SLA tracking  
• Act as a liaison between business and technology teams to ensure timely delivery and alignment with business objectives
